definitions.explanation: A physical space or opening between things.

definitions.gloss: unguarded moment, opening, chance to exploit
definitions.explanation: A moment of carelessness or vulnerability that can be taken advantage of. Common in martial arts, sports, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {隙|すき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}って→狙う：00313_nerau⟧⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{隙|すき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せたら→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧。
examples.english: If you show any opening, you'll lose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戸|と}→戸：00676_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隙|すき}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}ってくる→入ってくる：29060_haittekuru⟧。
examples.english: Cold air comes in through the gap in the door.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{隙|すき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ついて⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{攻|せ}めた→攻める：02123_semeru⟧。
examples.english: I exploited my opponent's opening and attacked all at once.

notes:
{隙|すき} has two main uses: a physical gap and a figurative opening or vulnerability.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隙|すき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧ (target an opening)
- {隙|すき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つく (exploit an opening)
- {隙|すき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せる→見せる：01988_miseru⟧ (show vulnerability)
- {隙|すき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (have no openings, be on guard)
- {隙|すき}⟦だらけ→〜だらけ：18372_darake⟧ (full of openings)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{隙間|すきま}→隙間：00389_sukima⟧: gap, crack, space between things (more concrete/physical than {隙|すき})

Not to be confused with ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧ (liking, fondness), which has the same reading.
